title: Duplicate rows inherit the merged atom's compiled label
statement: Under the hypotheses of D-FINITE-INDUCTIVE-CLOSURE on the merged atoms, a nearest-centroid rule built from the unmerged sample and its inherited labeling assigns every original duplicate row the label its atom carries.
assumptions: the merge sends each original row to an atom carrying its score
each atom's weight is the total weight of the rows merging into it
the hypotheses of D-FINITE-INDUCTIVE-CLOSURE hold on the merged atoms

proof_location.section: D6. Exact finite inductive closure / compiler

role: deployment of the compiled rule on unmerged data
